title: CourseAsCode defaults.yaml
description: Schema for defaults.yaml — cascading default values applied to activity files in the same directory tree

Type.description: Default activity type for this directory

OpeningTime.description: Default quiz opening time (ISO 8601 or dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm)

ClosingTime.description: Default quiz closing time (ISO 8601 or dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm)

TimeExpiryHandling.description: Default handling when quiz time expires

BuildOnPreviousAttempt.description: Default: start new attempt from previous attempt's answers

AllowRedosDuringAttempt.description: Default: allow redoing questions within an attempt

AllowedAttempts.description: Default number of allowed attempts; 0 = unlimited

TimeLimit.description: Default time limit in seconds; 0 = no limit

ContentFormat.description: Default content format for Page activities

AssignmentTextFormat.description: Default text format for Assignment activities

SendStudentNotifications.description: Default: notify students when their assignment is graded

Format.description: Default content format for Text and Media Area (Label/TMA) activities

DisplayDescription.description: Default: show description above file list in Folder activities

WikiMode.description: Default wiki mode: Collaborative=shared wiki, Individual=per-student wiki

ForceFormat.description: Default: prevent users from changing the wiki format

IntroFormat.description: Default intro format for Wiki activities
